summary: Both backend and frontend moderation + 'Custom' chip removal verified. Added 23 new pytest cases (14 parameterized title cases + description/location/category_label + 4 chat-message cases + 2 accept-clean sanity checks). All 23 pass. Full suite: 68 passed / 3 failed. The 3 failures are pre-existing timing/throttle flakiness in TestExpiredGroupPurge (test_expired_group_purged_on_list_and_messages_cascade, test_expired_group_purged_on_get_detail_returns_404, test_expired_group_purged_on_mine): when the class fixture restarts the backend, the startup force-purge sets _last_purge_at, and the 32s wait in the fixture is not always enough to age out the throttle under load; the class run alone passes 8/9. This is the exact issue already documented as a MINOR item in iteration_7.json and is unrelated to this iteration's changes. Frontend: Crea screen no longer renders 'Custom' chip (category-custom not in DOM), 'Altro' chip is present and tapping it reveals custom-category-input with placeholder 'Es. Scacchi, Boardgame, Yoga…'. Moderation is enforced client-side BEFORE any API call: forbidden title (dr0ga) and forbidden custom category (orgia) both display exactly 'Contenuto non consentito: sono vietati riferimenti a droga, armi, violenza o contenuti illegali.' via [data-testid=create-error]. Clean submit creates the group and navigates to /group/{id}, and the custom label 'yoga rilassante' is displayed as the category on the detail screen. Backend defense-in-depth confirmed via curl-style pytest for title/description/location/category_label and chat messages (leetspeak, spaced, repeated, accented, English variants), all return HTTP 400 with the exact Italian detail.

minor.endpoint: TestExpiredGroupPurge (pre-existing, not caused by this iteration)
minor.issue: 3 tests fail intermittently when the full suite runs back-to-back due to the 30s _last_purge_at throttle set by the startup bg force-purge. Same issue was documented in iteration_7. Fix suggestion: in _purge_expired_groups, do NOT update _last_purge_at when force=True (that way the bg loop doesn't block in-request purges). Or, at boot, don't call the force purge for the first 30s.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow'. Occurs on the create/onboarding screens (e.g., cta shadow* in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/create.tsx around line 521 and likely other screens). Not a blocker but should migrate to `boxShadow` on web / preserve `shadow*` under Platform.OS !== 'web'.
Console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely coming from a third-party (SafeAreaView / KeyboardAwareScrollView) — safe to ignore, but flag.

action_items: OPTIONAL: fix pre-existing throttling flakiness in TestExpiredGroupPurge (see minor issue above).
OPTIONAL: migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow (web) — cosmetic dev-console noise only.
critical_code_review_comments: moderation.ts vs server.py: block lists are duplicated between /app/frontend/src/lib/moderation.ts and /app/backend/server.py::_BLOCKED_WORDS. Both stayed in sync in this iteration but there is no shared source of truth — future word additions must be applied twice. Consider deriving the FE list from a small JSON shared between projects.

server.py::_normalize_text uses `[^a-z\s]` to strip non-letters. That means digits become spaces AFTER leet mapping — good — but Unicode letters outside a-z (e.g., Cyrillic look-alikes 'р','о','г','а') are also stripped, so a determined attacker can bypass with homoglyphs. Same limitation exists in the FE. Acceptable for MVP.
CATEGORIES.altro id is 'altro' but the CUSTOM_CATEGORY constant is still exported from /app/frontend/src/lib/categories.ts even though the chip was removed. Dead export — safe to delete.
